messages:
Rita: Quick thought 0min0100000: Can we stop showing the full-width quickstart banner for users who pick a template during signup? It feels redundant with the checklist. Maya: I noticed analytics: users who interact with checklist complete setup 30% faster than those clicking banner. Might be funnel noise though. Kevin: Banner drives discovery for non-technical roles. Maybe we show banner only for new orgs with >1 seat? Or show compact banner that pushes to checklist. Olivia: I prototyped a compact banner that anchors to the right rail and transitions into the checklist step when clicked. Link: https://figma.com/file/def456/onboard-rail-compact Ben: From research: PMs often don't know 'templates' term. They search for 'sample app' or 'starter'. Microcopy matters here. Suggest label: 'Start from template' vs 'Start from sample app' A/B test. Sam: Accessibility note: if the banner collapses into the checklist, ensure we move focus to the checklist and announce the change. Use aria-live and role=list for steps. aria-bot: Accessibility scan results: recommend role="list" on checklist, aria-expanded on banner toggle, and aria-live="polite" for status updates. Also suggest visible focus styles for compact banner CTA. Sam: example aria snippet: ```html
Step 1: Create workspace
Step 2: Add sample app
Sample added to workspace
``` Sam: Note: aria-live needs to be updated programmatically after success, not on initial render. Maya: Enterprise/Dedicated customers: we should replace hosted samples with 'Apply workspace template' and surface docs for offline registries. Kevin: Agree. Add a variant for Private deployments that shows 'Upload template' flow instead of import. Track variant with EXP-512. Rita: For keyboard users, can we put a single 'next' shortcut that moves through checklist steps? Might help power users. Sam: Careful: keyboard shortcuts should be discoverable in command palette. Also avoid single-letter shortcuts that conflict with browser shortcuts. Olivia: I'll add a visual hint: 'Open command palette (Ctrl+K) to search templates' near the checklist footer. Ben: For user testing, can we run 5 moderated sessions focusing on PMs and non-devs? I'll schedule and report next Wed. Maya: OK action items: Olivia to update Figma with compact rail banner + checklist transition states; Kevin to create EXP-512 and add telemetry; Sam to add ARIA acceptance criteria; Ben to set up usability sessions; Rita to draft copy variants. ci-bot: CI: running tests for branch onboard-compact-banner (build #128). ETA ~10m. :gear: Rita: Thanks all, will collect notes and post a short summary in the experiments board.
